corrections.receipt_claim: mutation_matrix.summary is {"caught": 17} with a read note about eight passes and 17 of 17 caught.
corrections.truth_as_measured: That is a statement about the seventeen mutants I chose. The reviewer built its own matrix and found six guards that survive BOTH my bound command and its in-package oracle: R1-M09 VersionRef entity_type leg, R1-M10 input_revision positivity, R1-M16c per-stage reader-action wording, R1-M21 the Jev receipt required-key loop, R1-M28 s.effective on the adoption ref, and R1-M32 the probe depth cap. Cause: my mutants flipped whole conditions while these are single legs of compound conditions, so no input in the 64-id roster isolates any one leg.
